subject.title: TUI: Support Shift+Enter for newline (Enter to send)

question: Should OpenClaw expose a supported TUI send/newline keybinding preference, or limit this issue to documenting current pi-tui newline behavior and fallbacks?
rationale: Current main already gets Shift+Enter/Ctrl+J newline support from pi-tui, but the requested configurable behavior would add or wire a public keybinding/config surface where repository policy sets a high compatibility bar.

options.title: Document Current Behavior First
options.body: Update docs and /help for Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, terminal limitations, and backslash-enter fallback while deferring a config bridge to a separate explicit decision.

options.title: Approve TUI Keybinding Bridge
options.body: Wire the existing keybinding manager into openclaw tui with focused docs, tests, and upgrade-safe configuration behavior.

options.title: Close As Sufficient
options.body: Treat dependency-level Shift+Enter/Ctrl+J support as enough and decline public docs/help/config follow-up.

recommendation.title: Document Current Behavior First
recommendation.body: Update docs and /help for Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, terminal limitations, and backslash-enter fallback while deferring a config bridge to a separate explicit decision.

likelyOwner.reason: The current TUI wrapper/docs history and the prior maintainer review both route the product choice here.
